Swaziland 1971

Swaziland National Football League 1971

Division 1

Final table, as published in the "Times of Swaziland" 3rd December 1971:

 1.Milling Hotspurs   10  8  2  0  22- 7  18  Champions
 2.Mbabane City       10  7  0  3  31-16  14
 3.Hhohho Red Lions   10  4  3  3  23-17  11
 4.Golden Eagles      10  1  3  6  20-32   5     ga 0.625
 5.Swazi Rail Hawks   10  2  3  5  11-21   5*    ga 0.524
 6.Home Sparrows      10  2  1  7  19-37   5     ga 0.514
* Penalized 2 points for fielding an ineligible player.

NB: 4 more goals conceded than scored
